name: PC Insiders World Elite Mastercard

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: First-year annual fee waived; PC Optimum points can be redeemed toward the annual fee.

apr.notes: Standard rates: 21.99% on purchases; 22.97% on cash advances (21.97% in Quebec).

credit_required.notes: Minimum $80,000 personal or $150,000 household annual income.

base_rate.description: 10 points per $1 (1% back) on dining, transit and everywhere else.

categories.label: Shoppers Drug Mart and Pharmaprix (5% back)
Participating grocery stores (4% back, plus 2% more on eligible pickup orders)

rewards.redemption_notes: 10,000 PC Optimum points redeem for a $7 statement credit toward the card balance, or for rewards in stores.

notes: Network tier is World Elite Mastercard per the card name. Includes a PC Express Pass subscription; an existing PC Optimum Insiders subscription is cancelled on approval. Earn rates are shown on the page as percent back in PC Optimum points; 10 points per $1 equals 1% back, so rates are recorded as points per $1. Gas earns points per litre at Esso and Mobil stations, which is not a per-dollar rate.
